transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ____. What brings you in today?

Well... I guess I'm here because people keep acting like I'm just imagining things. But I'm not. I know the hospital people and... some folks from the agency, they've been watching our house. And my cleaning routes at work. They're trying to see if I'm taking proper care of my husband. That's... that's really all I want to say about it right now.
Have you been hearing or seeing things that other people don’t seem to experience?

I don't... I don't really know what other people hear. But... sometimes, when the house is completely quiet, I hear a woman's voice. 

She's usually over near the kitchen window. She just... she tells me to check the locks. Or to move his pills. I'm not making it up, it's... it's as clear as if she's standing right there next to me.
Have you been using any alcohol, cannabis, or other drugs recently?
No. I don't use any of that. I don't drink, and I... I certainly don't take drugs.
Have you had times of depression or times of feeling unusually energized or overly confident when these voices were happening?

I don't know about... overly confident. But... I suppose there were a few weeks recently where I wasn't sleeping very much. I was just... keeping busy, I guess. Running from my cleaning jobs to church errands, mostly. 

And... yes. During those weeks, I was still hearing that woman's voice. And... knowing that certain people were monitoring my routes. That's... that's really all it was.
During those times, did you also feel depressed most of the day nearly every day?
No... I wouldn't say that. I didn't feel sad, if that's what you mean. I was just... like I said, I was busy.
Have the voices or beliefs ever continued when your mood and sleep were otherwise back to normal?

Yes... I suppose so. There was a... a quieter spell, I guess you could call it. A few weeks where I was sleeping more normally. I wasn't rushing around so much. 

But... the voice was still there. I'd still hear her by the kitchen window. And... I still knew that agency was watching us. So, yes. It didn't stop just because I was resting more.
Have you ever had a period when you were hearing the voice or believing you were being watched even though you were not having any mood symptoms at all?
I... I think I just answered that. Like I said... there was that quiet spell where I was sleeping fine and... not rushing around. And she was still there. So... yes. I guess.
During the times when you were sleeping very little, did you also feel unusually energized or like you had too much energy?

I suppose you could say that. I just... I get moving before daylight. There's a lot to do. Cleaning, cooking, calling about appointments... making new lists. I take on church errands, too. People tell me to slow down, but... I just keep going.
Have you ever had the voices or the feeling that people were watching you when you were not also having those periods of increased energy or reduced sleep?

I... yes. Like I mentioned before. There was that... that stretch of time. A few weeks. I was sleeping. I wasn't rushing. But... she was still there by the window. And I still knew they were watching. So... yes.
Have you had a period of at least two weeks when you felt depressed most of the day nearly every day?
No... I don't think so. I mean, I get tired from working, but... I don't really sit around feeling sad like that. So, no.
Have you ever had a period of at least one week when you felt so unusually high or irritable that other people said you were not yourself?

I... I guess there are stretches. Sometimes I just feel... bright, you know? Strong. Like I can handle everything that needs doing. But... well, if my husband or one of my cleaning clients questions how I'm doing something during those times... I might snap at them. Harder than I mean to, I suppose. People might say I'm... a bit much, then.
Have the voices or beliefs ever continued for at least two weeks when you were not having any manic or depressive symptoms?

I think I just said that... yes. There was a time, a few weeks, where things were... quieter. I was sleeping. I wasn't rushing around. But the voice was still by the kitchen window. And I still knew the agency was watching. So... yes.
Have you ever had a period of at least one week when you felt so unusually high or irritable that you were clearly not yourself?
I... didn't you just ask me that? Like I said... there are stretches where I feel bright, and I might snap at my husband or the people I work for. I don't really know what else to tell you about it.
Have you ever had a time when your mood was so unusually elevated or irritable that you had much more energy than usual and needed much less sleep than normal?

I suppose... yes. There are nights where I only get... maybe two or three hours of sleep. But I don't really feel tired like I used to after a short night. I just... wake up ready to scrub floors, or sort through papers. That's all.
How certain are you that the agency is watching you—could it be mistaken, or are you completely convinced it is true?

I'm... I'm completely convinced. I wouldn't be here if I wasn't. People just keep acting like I'm imagining it. But I know they are watching. The hospital people, and folks from the agency... they watch our house. They watch my cleaning routes. They just want to see if I'm taking proper care of my husband. I know what I see.
Have there been any times when the voices or the belief that you were being watched were present only while your mood and energy were otherwise completely normal?

I suppose... yes. There was a quieter spell a while back. For a few weeks, maybe. I was sleeping more... not rushing around so much. But... I still heard that voice by the kitchen window. And I still knew the agency was watching us. So... yes.
Have you ever had a period of at least one week when you felt so unusually elevated or irritable that you were clearly not yourself?

I guess so... yes. There are stretches where I just feel... bright. Strong. Like I can handle everything that needs doing. But... well, if my husband asks what I'm doing, or a client questions how I cleaned something... I snap at them. Much harder than I mean to. I just... lose my temper.
Have there ever been any times when the voice or the belief that you were being watched went away completely?
No... I don't think so. Not completely. It's just... always there, I guess.
Have you ever had voices or beliefs like this for at least two weeks at a time when you were not having any mood symptoms at all?

I... I thought I just said that. Um... yes. There was that quieter spell. For a few weeks, I think. My mood was fine... I was sleeping normally, not rushing around. But... the voice was still there. By the window. And I still knew they were watching. So... yes. For a few weeks.
Have you ever had a period of at least four days when you felt so unusually energized or irritable that other people clearly noticed you were not yourself?
I don't really know. Um... I don't keep track of the days like that. I just know about the stretches I already told you about. I'm not sure about four days.
